title: Law to require delivery apps to carry accident insurance
summary: This bill would require third-party food delivery services to maintain liability insurance covering injuries, deaths or property damage caused by delivery workers using e-bikes or other powered devices during trips or on-call time. Minimum coverage would be $100,000 per person, $300,000 per accident and $50,000 for property damage. A delivery service's license would be voided if it fails to obtain or maintain this insurance, and the law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
